attributes.cvedb_kev_relay: CISA KEV status relayed by Shodan CVEDB {listed, required_action, ransomware_campaign, note}: context only, the KEV card line and the 'kev' fact come from cisa_kev (P182 cond 4)
attributes.cvedb_search_hits: list of {cve, cvss, epss, epss_percentile, kev_relay, published, vendor_products} of a Shodan CVEDB product search typed by the analyst (rows de-duplicated by CVE id)
attributes.euvd_record: ENISA EUVD record of the CVE {euvd_id, assigner, published, updated, exploited_since, references_total, advisories_total, link}; the EUVD id is an alias, never an entity
attributes.euvd_advisories: list of vendor advisories ENISA EUVD relays for the CVE {id, source, title, published, url} (links only, capped)
attributes.euvd_search_hits: list of {euvd_id, cves, score, exploited_since, published, description} of an EUVD text search typed by the analyst (size <= 10)
attributes.csaf_advisories: vendor CSAF 2.0 advisories of the CVE from the local CSAF index {vendor, advisory_id, title, url, distribution_url, licence, updated, cvss, excerpt (<= 300 chars), exploitation, status_counts, hash}: excerpts plus links, never copies
attributes.csaf_index: provenance of the local CSAF index that answered {vendors: {vendor: {synced_at, documents, deferred}}, age_hours, stale}
attributes.csaf_search_hits: list of {cve, vendor, advisory_id, title} of local CSAF advisories whose title or products match a keyword
attributes.vex_statuses: vendor VEX statement for the CVE {vendor, advisory_id, counts {fixed, affected, not_affected, under_investigation}, products [{status, component, platform, platform_cpe, justification, remediation}] (capped), url}
attributes.debian_tracker: Debian security tracker summary of the CVE or source package {packages, releases, open, resolved, not_affected, scope, description, index {built_at, ids, packages}}: shown only for analyst input or Debian-based assets (P355 cond 2)
attributes.debian_package_status: list of {cve, release, codename, status, fixed, urgency, nodsa} of one Debian source package in the local tracker index (newest CVE ids first, capped)
attributes.distro_backport: backport check of version-inferred CVEs against the distribution's own fix status {distro, package, installed, release, fixed: [cve], unfixed: [cve], not_affected: [cve], unknown: [cve], evidence}
